text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While looking for Mejiro Dober, who hadn't 
shown up even though it was time for 
training—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Aromas are nice, but the natural scents of 
the outdoors are still so calming...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!? No, I mean... It doesn't really 
matter, does it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you came too, Trainer. ...I'm just 
taking a quick breather.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I've rested enough, so it's about time I 
head back—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I've rested enough, so it's about time I 
head back—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Wait, is it training time 
already...!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I relaxed too much. ...Sorry... for 
standing you up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, there was no time left to do 
any training.
